claims.text: The resort is on the Ionian Sea in Costa Navarino, surrounded by centuries-old olive groves, golf courses and a sandy beach.

findings.quote: Located along the Ionian Sea in Costa Navarino
Surrounded by centuries-old olive groves, rolling golf courses and a spectacular sandy beach

claims.text: Room and suite design is inspired by old Messinian mansions.

findings.quote: inspired in design by old Messinian mansions that spring from nature

claims.text: The two-level Westin Pool spans two separate pools with a waterfall backdrop.

findings.quote: With a distinctive design and a relaxing backdrop of the waterfalls sound, the two-levelled Westin Pool covers a total surface of 851m2 across two separate pools

claims.text: The palm-fringed Lagoon Pool is at the heart of the resort and has a kids' pool.

findings.quote: At the heart of the resort, you will find the elegant Lagoon Pool surrounded by palm trees. It consists of one pool with a total surface of 890m2 and depth of 1.2m, and a kids’ pool

claims.text: The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio has an indoor pool.

findings.quote: our fully equipped WestinWORKOUT® Fitness Studio offers an indoor pool

claims.text: The seasonal Aqua Park has three slides and a play pool.

findings.quote: The Aqua Park, which operates seasonally, and is fun for all ages with three slides and a play pool.

claims.text: The resort has two children's hubs, Cocoon and SandCastle.

findings.quote: offering two specially designed hubs for children, Cocoon and SandCastle.

claims.text: Sports programmes for young guests include the NBA Basketball School, Juventus Academy Resort Experience and Mouratoglou Junior Tennis Camp.

findings.quote: international sports programmes, including NBA Basketball School, Juventus Academy Resort Experience and Mouratoglou Junior Tennis Camp.

claims.text: The 1827 bar is named after the naval battle in the nearby Bay of Navarino during the Greek War of Independence.

findings.quote: 1827 is named after one of the most important events of the Greek War of Independence, the famous naval battle that took place in the nearby Bay of Navarino.

claims.text: The Dunes Beach is a sandy, west-facing beach on the Ionian Sea that stretches for 1 km, with sun loungers and umbrellas.

findings.quote: Washed by the sparkling blue waters of the Ionian Sea, The Dunes Beach stretches for 1 km under the warm glow of the Messinian sun. This sandy, west-facing beach, with cozy sun loungers and umbrellas

claims.text: Many rooms and suites have unobstructed Ionian Sea views, and some ground-floor units have an individual infinity pool.

findings.quote: Many rooms and suites enjoy unobstructed views of the Ionian Sea, some ground floor units have an individual infinity pool

claims.text: Anazoe Spa treatments combine ancient Greek healing rituals and local resources such as olive leaves, Messinian citrus, herbs, flowers and sea salts with European spa therapies.

findings.quote: All Anazoe Spa treatments are based on progressive techniques that combine ancient Greek healing rituals and local resources with traditional European spa treatments and therapies.
Nature lends itself to the treatments with elements such as purifying olive leaves, refreshing Messinian citrus, herbs, flowers and sea salts.

claims.text: The Dunes Course, designed by Bernhard Langer with European Golf Design, is the first signature golf course in Greece, with sea and river views.

findings.quote: the impressive seaside Dunes Course is the first signature golf course in Greece, designed by two-time US Masters Champion and former Ryder Cup Captain Bernhard Langer in association with European Golf Design.
offers unique style and playability with spectacular sea and river views

claims.text: The Mouratoglou Tennis Center, its first European location, has 12 tennis courts, 3 padel courts and 2 pickleball courts with Ionian Sea views.

findings.quote: The first European location for a Mouratoglou Tennis Center offers the opportunity to play on brand new, state-of-the-art courts with breathtaking views of the Ionian Sea
offers 12 brand new Tennis Courts, 3 Padel Courts & 2 Pickleball Courts.

claims.text: The resort is a 45-minute drive from Kalamata Airport and three hours from Athens Airport.

findings.quote: Located just a 45-minute drive from Kalamata Airport and three hours from Athens Airport
Kindly note that the outdoor pools operate seasonal

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location means off-resort outings need planned transportation.
